d: MLC Election 2026 ki 4 shikshak nirvachan siton men sabse chaunkane vala aur bara rajnitik ulatpher patna shikshak sit par huaa hai. pichhle 30 salon (1996 se lagatar 5 bar) se is sit par kabij bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ke kaddavar neta aur nivartaman emaelsi naval kishor yadav ka abhedy kila aakhirkar dhvast ho gaya hai. rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke pratyashi do. sanjiv kumar ne 1,057 voton ke bare antar se naval kishor yadav ko patakhni dekar is sit par kabja jama liya hai. do. sanjiv kumar ko 4,487 vot mile, jabki bijepi ke naval kishor yadav ko 3,430 vot hi prapt ho sake. jit ke bad do.…
